summary: John Marshall Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing its board extended its stock repurchase program, originally adopted August 18, 2021, from an August 31, 2026 expiry to August 31, 2027, or earlier if fully utilized. The program authorizes repurchases of up to 700,000 shares (about 5% of outstanding shares; ~14.11 million shares as of June 30, 2026). Repurchases may occur in open market or privately negotiated transactions, subject to Rule 10b-18 and 10b5-1 plans; repurchased shares are cancelled. No specific price or timing was disclosed. Watch for periodic repurchase activity in quarterly filings.
